original.target_description: Meyer et al. (2013), study 1, Stroop task, ERN at FCz internal consistency at 20 error trials. Selected direct-replication reliability target; exact intended outcome/test is not uniquely identified by supplied task-only locator.

n.sample_role: participants contributing to the selected task-specific ERN coefficient-alpha estimate
n.exclusions: 47 recruited; 2 excluded for fewer than six errors in at least one task and 2 for excessive EEG artifacts; final sample 43. At 20 errors 41 remained for flanker/Stroop and 40 for go/no-go.
n.quote: Overall, 41 participants committed at least 20 errors during the flankers and Stroop task

es.quote: the Stroop task did not attain a Cronbach’s alpha over .50, even after 20 errors were committed

replication.target_description: Holbrook et al., supplied xr6bn preprint, study 1, Aim 1 direct replication, Stroop ERN coefficient alpha at 20 error trials.

n.sample_role: participants contributing to the selected task-specific ERN coefficient-alpha estimate
n.exclusions: 205 recruited; 23 with fewer than six artifact-free error trials in any task excluded, leaving 182. Further task-specific availability depends on trial cutoff.
n.quote: The number of participants available to calculate α for the Stroop task at 20 trials was 151.

es.quote: When examining data from 20 error trials, α for Stroop ERN scores was 0.61 (95% CI: 0.52, 0.70).

reported_success.quote: hypothesis #1 was not supported for the Stroop task.

notes: Both retrieved primary full texts have titles and authors matching the assigned references. Supplied replication p. 40 contains references in the retrieved 73-page preprint; task-specific direct replication results are on p. 15. The task-only descriptions do not identify outcome, trial count, or statistical contrast, and request d although these direct-replication results report coefficient alpha. target_match remains null because exact intended test cannot be established. Selected the direct-replication ERN reliability target corresponding to the original discussion near p. 1223. No d conversion performed. No p value is reported for the selected alpha estimates; confidence intervals are not p values. Original/repl sample sizes refer to the selected trial cutoffs, not generic recruitment totals. Original gives only the threshold that alpha did not exceed .50 at 20 trials, not an exact coefficient; es.value remains null. For the conceptual replication (Aim 2), the authors report support for Stroop on p. 16; the saved failed verdict refers specifically to Aim 1 direct replication, not an overall-paper verdict.
